purpose: Repeat the exact full C2B coupled sequence with the already compiled test-only participant failure accessors and the now-available local MODFLOW6 library, capturing the first failed serial participant at the existing Richards transaction blocker.

instrumentation.scope: Expose first failed serial participant cell index, tile index, participant status and registry-local status. The generated overlays compile only into a temporary research library; tracked production source and the canonical build remain untouched.

gates.replay: Two fresh processes with separate output directories must produce byte-identical normalized summary and identical first-failure attribution.
gates.rollback: Failure must preserve the complete committed SWAP state, storage, all participant revisions and interface ledgers; MODFLOW must not finalize the rejected window.
gates.source_validation: All compiled production src blobs must match the pinned canonical source tree except the two explicitly listed temporary overlays.
gates.failure_oracle: Previously observed baseline is 15,239 published windows followed by the first rejection at t=0.015239 day, near 0.0044255034 cm/day. Any deviation is reported as a replay discrepancy, not tuned away.
gates.production_delta: None. Do not change solver, temporal or mass gates; do not change coupling tolerance, forcing schedule, retry behavior or ownership semantics.

persisted_outputs: compact first-failure summary for each process
full result hashes and replay identity
claim_boundary: Participant attribution is diagnostic for this exact research C2B trajectory only. It does not establish a spatially unique physical defect or justify any production numerical change.
